probe: SELECT version() AS product, current_setting('server_version') AS version, current_database() AS catalog,(SELECT pg_catalog.string_agg(p.proname, ',') FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p WHERE p.proname IN ('aurora_version','yb_servers')) AS compatible_product

queries.sql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema, c.relname AS name FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=%s AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND NOT c.relispartition ORDER BY c.relname

SELECT n.nspname AS schema,c.relname AS name,a.attname AS column_name,pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) AS data_type,a.attnum AS ordinal,NOT a.attnotnull AS nullable FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=%s AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND NOT c.relispartition AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY c.relname,a.attnum

SELECT n.nspname AS schema,t.relname AS name,c.conname AS constraint_name,CASE c.contype WHEN 'p' THEN 'primary_key' WHEN 'f' THEN 'foreign_key' WHEN 'u' THEN 'unique' WHEN 'c' THEN 'check' END AS constraint_kind,a.attname AS column_name,rn.nspname AS ref_schema,rt.relname AS ref_table,ra.attname AS ref_column FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class t ON t.oid=c.conrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.relnamespace LEFT JOIN LATERAL unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(attnum,pos) ON true LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=t.oid AND a.attnum=k.attnum LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class rt ON rt.oid=c.confrelid LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace rn ON rn.oid=rt.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute ra ON ra.attrelid=rt.oid AND ra.attnum=c.confkey[k.pos] WHERE n.nspname=%s AND NOT t.relispartition AND c.contype IN ('p','f','u','c') ORDER BY t.relname,c.conname,k.pos

SELECT n.nspname AS schema,i.relname AS name,t.relname AS table_name,a.attname AS column_name,x.indisunique AS is_unique FROM pg_catalog.pg_index x JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class i ON i.oid=x.indexrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class t ON t.oid=x.indrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.relnamespace LEFT JOIN LATERAL unnest(x.indkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(attnum,pos) ON true LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=t.oid AND a.attnum=k.attnum WHERE n.nspname=%s AND NOT t.relispartition ORDER BY i.relname,k.pos
SELECT schemaname AS schema,viewname AS name FROM pg_catalog.pg_views WHERE schemaname=%s ORDER BY viewname

SELECT CASE p.prokind WHEN 'p' THEN 'procedure' ELSE 'function' END AS object_kind,n.nspname AS schema,p.proname || '(' || pg_catalog.oidvectortypes(p.proargtypes) || ')' AS name FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname=%s ORDER BY name

SELECT n.nspname AS schema,c.relname || '.' || t.tgname AS name FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=%s AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND NOT c.relispartition ORDER BY name

SELECT current_setting('track_counts') AS enabled,s.schemaname AS schema,s.relname AS name,s.n_live_tup AS value,GREATEST(s.last_analyze,s.last_autoanalyze)::text AS updated_at,CASE WHEN c.relispartition THEN 'partition' ELSE 'table' END AS granularity FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_user_tables s JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=s.relid WHERE s.schemaname=%s

SELECT n.nspname AS schema,c.relname AS name,pg_catalog.pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS value,CASE WHEN c.relispartition THEN 'partition' ELSE 'table' END AS granularity FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=%s AND c.relkind IN ('r','p')

SELECT current_setting('track_counts') AS enabled,s.schemaname AS schema,s.indexrelname AS name,s.idx_scan AS value,(SELECT stats_reset::text FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_database WHERE datname=current_database()) AS reset_at,CASE WHEN i.relispartition THEN 'partition_index' ELSE 'index' END AS granularity FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_user_indexes s JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class i ON i.oid=s.indexrelid WHERE s.schemaname=%s
